what: The small logo plate (172×44) at the header center grows in place when the menu button is pressed, to 680px wide and the inner height, over .5s cubic-bezier(.35,0,.35,1), and the inner menu appears .12s later over .3s. The background dims over .35s (scrim). Pressing again, or the scrim, or Esc shrinks it on the same curve and the inner menu vanishes immediately over .3s. On narrow windows the width stays and only the height grows

options.delay: Delay in seconds before the inside appears, default .12
options.narrow: Width is left unchanged in windows narrower than this width (px), default 1023
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Always-visible top row (logo, buttons) — its height is the closed height
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Inner part revealed as it grows (menu links · News)
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (If any) scrim covering the back — click to close

from.where: shared.js header .tw-panel (logo panel + menu links + News ticker strip)
